column1: # 多音字 fixes, applied ONLY to the text sent to the TTS engine (pages and keys keep the real text).
# word <TAB> pinyin <TAB> substitute.  Longest match wins, scanning left to right.
# A substitute character must be common, have exactly ONE reading, and the same syllable + tone.
# substitute = word itself  -> "protect": the word is read as-is and blocks shorter rules (e.g. 大都, 快乐).
# 乐 yuè→月 (lè words such as 快乐 stay as they are)
# 差 chà→岔 chā→插 chāi→拆
# 藏 zàng→葬 (cáng is the usual reading)
# 应 yìng→映 (应该 yīng stays)
# 曲 qǔ→取 (qū as in 曲线 stays)
# ---- added after scanning the collected lesson texts (polyscan.ps1) ----
# ---- protect: usual-reading words; a rule is skipped when it overlaps one of these (e.g. 医生长期, 进行长期) ----
